coverageNotes: Recognizes the documented Convex boundary under supplied conditions. Does not establish independent implementation skill or all source requirements.

questions.concept: A failed mutation rolls back all event database effects
questions.question: After the HTTP response, what is stored?

options.text: The subscription is canceled at sequence 2; the receipt exists.
options.rationale: Awaiting each write does not commit it independently; the uncaught mutation error rolls both back.

options.text: The subscription is canceled at sequence 2; no receipt exists.
options.rationale: The earlier patch belongs to the same transaction and also rolls back.

options.text: The subscription is active at sequence 1; no receipt exists.
options.rationale: Both writes roll back before runMutation rejects. Catching in the HTTP action does not commit the failed mutation.

options.text: The subscription is active at sequence 1; the receipt exists.
options.rationale: The receipt insert and subscription patch share the mutation transaction, so the receipt cannot commit alone.
